name: context-nudge
description: Nudges you to /clear at the right moment: after a commit in a long session, when the context gets very long, and when you come back to an expired cache. Shows usage in tokens, or estimated cost in dollars for API users.

language.title: Language
language.description: Reminder language: auto (follows $LANG), en, zh-TW, zh-CN, ja, or ko

unit.title: Show usage as
unit.description: tokens (default, works for Pro/Max plans) or usd (estimated cost at API prices, for pay-as-you-go API users)

remind_at_breakpoint.title: Remind after a commit/push/PR from (tokens)
remind_at_breakpoint.description: Context size from which a commit, push, or PR triggers a reminder

remind_always.title: Always remind from (tokens)
remind_always.description: Context size from which you are reminded even mid-task

remind_step.title: Remind again every (tokens)
remind_step.description: After a reminder, stay quiet until the context grows by this much

idle_min_tokens.title: Expired-cache warning from (tokens)
idle_min_tokens.description: Only warn about an expired cache when the context is at least this large
